mapper.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN l.defect_log_type = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS create_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.defect_log_type = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repair_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.defect_log_type IN (3, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verify_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_member_operation_statistic (stat_date, project_id, user_id, create_count, repair_count, verify_count, create_time) SELECT DATE(l.create_time) AS stat_date, d.project_id, l.create_by AS user_id, , NOW() FROM sys_defect_log l INNER JOIN sys_defect d ON d.defect_id = l.defect_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE l.create_time >= #{startTime} AND l.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(l.create_time), d.project_id, l.create_by ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE create_count = VALUES(create_count), repair_count = VALUES(repair_count), verify_count = VALUES(verify_count), create_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO sys_member_operation_statistic (stat_date, project_id, user_id, create_count, repair_count, verify_count, create_time) SELECT CAST(l.create_time AS DATE) AS stat_date, d.project_id, l.create_by AS user_id, , NOW() FROM sys_defect_log l INNER JOIN sys_defect d ON d.defect_id = l.defect_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE l.create_time >= PARSEDATETIME(#{startTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AND l.create_time < PARSEDATETIME(#{endTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') GROUP BY CAST(l.create_time AS DATE), d.project_id, l.create_by
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_member_operation_statistic WHERE stat_date >= CAST(PARSEDATETIME(#{startTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DATE) AND stat_date < CAST(PARSEDATETIME(#{endTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS DATE)
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, IFNULL(SUM(s.create_count), 0) AS create_count, IFNULL(SUM(s.repair_count), 0) AS repair_count, IFNULL(SUM(s.verify_count), 0) AS verify_count FROM sys_user_project up INNER JOIN sys_user_project up2 ON up2.project_id = up.project_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = up2.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_member_operation_statistic s ON s.project_id = up2.project_id AND s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.stat_date >= #{startDate} AND s.stat_date <= #{endDate} WHERE up.user_id = #{currentUserId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar ORDER BY create_count DESC, repair_count DESC, verify_count DESC, u.nick_name ASC

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, IFNULL(SUM(s.create_count), 0) AS create_count, IFNULL(SUM(s.repair_count), 0) AS repair_count, IFNULL(SUM(s.verify_count), 0) AS verify_count FROM sys_user_project up INNER JOIN sys_user_project up2 ON up2.project_id = up.project_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = up2.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_member_operation_statistic s ON s.project_id = up2.project_id AND s.user_id = u.user_id AND s.stat_date >= CAST(PARSEDATETIME(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE) AND s.stat_date <= CAST(PARSEDATETIME(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS DATE) WHERE up.user_id = #{currentUserId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar ORDER BY create_count DESC, repair_count DESC, verify_count DESC, u.nick_name ASC
